title: Build a simple daily routine
description: Create a realistic routine with time for learning, rest, and responsibilities.
steps: Write down your fixed daily commitments.
Choose three important tasks for tomorrow.
Give each task a realistic time slot.
Review your plan at the end of the day.

quiz.q: What makes a daily routine more useful?
options: Planning every minute with no breaks
Choosing realistic priorities and reviewing them
Adding as many tasks as possible
quiz.explanation: A realistic routine prioritizes important tasks and leaves room for breaks.

title: Kitchen safety basics
description: Learn simple habits that help reduce common kitchen risks.
steps: Wash hands before handling food.
Keep raw and ready-to-eat foods separate.
Turn pan handles inward and keep flammable items away from heat.
Switch off appliances after use.

quiz.q: What should you do with raw and ready-to-eat foods?
options: Leave both at room temperature all day
quiz.explanation: Separating raw and ready-to-eat foods helps prevent cross-contamination.

title: Make a basic monthly budget
description: Understand income, needs, wants, savings, and spending review.
steps: List your monthly income.
Write down essential expenses.
Set a realistic savings target.
Track spending and adjust your plan monthly.

quiz.q: What is a useful first step when budgeting?
quiz.explanation: A budget starts with understanding the money coming in and going out.

title: Prepare a basic first-aid kit
description: Learn what a simple home first-aid kit can contain and when to seek help.
steps: Include adhesive bandages and sterile gauze.
Add disposable gloves and medical tape.
Keep essential emergency contacts nearby.
Check expiry dates and follow local health guidance.

quiz.q: What should you do with expired first-aid supplies?
options: Check guidance and replace them safely
quiz.explanation: Check expiry dates regularly and replace expired items. Seek professional help for serious injuries.

title: Use a focused study session
description: Break learning into focused sessions with clear goals and short breaks.
steps: Choose one specific learning goal.
Remove distractions and prepare materials.
Study for a manageable block of time.
Recall the main points without looking at notes.

quiz.q: Which action helps check what you have learned?
options: Recall the main points from memory
quiz.explanation: Active recall helps you check your understanding.

title: Write a professional email
description: Structure a clear email with a subject, greeting, request, and sign-off.
steps: Write a short, specific subject line.
Greet the recipient politely.
State the purpose and required action clearly.
Close politely and proofread before sending.

quiz.q: What belongs in a useful email subject line?
options: A clear summary of the purpose
quiz.explanation: A concise subject line helps the recipient understand the email purpose.

title: Practice active listening
description: Build stronger conversations by paying attention and checking understanding.
steps: Give the speaker your attention.
Avoid interrupting.
Ask a clarifying question when needed.
Summarize what you heard respectfully.

quiz.q: What is an example of active listening?
options: Planning your reply while ignoring the speaker
Summarizing the speaker’s point to confirm understanding
quiz.explanation: Reflecting back the message helps confirm understanding.

title: Learn five useful words
description: Use a small daily vocabulary habit to improve language learning.
steps: Choose five useful words around one topic.
Read their meanings and pronunciation.
Write one sentence for each word.
Review them the next day.

quiz.q: What helps vocabulary stick over time?
options: Using words in sentences and revisiting them
Memorizing a long list once only
quiz.explanation: Using words and reviewing them over time supports retention.

title: Start a daily sketch habit
description: Use short, low-pressure practice to build a creative habit.
steps: Choose a simple object nearby.
Observe its basic shapes.
Sketch for five minutes without judging the result.
Save your sketch and notice one thing to improve.

quiz.q: What is a good goal for beginner sketch practice?
options: Avoid drawing until you feel ready
quiz.explanation: Regular practice and small improvements are realistic beginner goals.

title: Know your emergency plan
description: Prepare important contacts and a simple plan for emergencies.
steps: Know your local emergency number.
Keep key contacts accessible.
Agree on a meeting point with household members.
Follow instructions from emergency services.

quiz.q: During a serious emergency, whose instructions should you follow?
options: Emergency services and official local guidance
quiz.explanation: Use official emergency guidance and verified information.

title: Spot a suspicious link
description: Recognize common warning signs before opening a link or sharing information.
steps: Check the sender and the full domain carefully.
Be cautious of urgency, prizes, or threats.
Do not enter passwords from a message link.
Open the official website directly or verify through another channel.

quiz.q: A message asks you to urgently sign in through an unfamiliar link. What is safest?
options: Verify the message and open the official site directly
quiz.explanation: Verify unexpected messages and avoid entering credentials through suspicious links.
